1. Install VM / Physical Server (OEL 7.9) & Network setup - Linux Admin - oraclelab2
	- userid & pawword (mallik, oracle, root)
	- Hostname and IP (oraclelab1.localdomain.com/192.168.1.101)
	- putty or mobaxterm

Option 1: - VM Install from scratch 
	- Install oracle VM virtual manager (Hyperwiser) - Oracle VM VirtualBox https://www.virtualbox.org
	- VM setup (oraclelab1) 
	- Download Linux ISO image - https://edelivery.oracle.com/ (Oracle Linux 7.9.0.0.0 ( Oracle Linux )
		- Oracle Linux 7.9.0.0.0 ( Oracle Linux ) 
		- V1009690-01.iso - Oracle Linux Release 7 Update 9 for x86 (64 bit), 4.5 GB
		
	- Install VM from ISO image 
		- /boot (600MB) (1G)
		- swap (2x times of RAM) (15G)
		- / (34GB)

Option 2: 
	- oraclelelabl2.rar - Reday VM 
	- Use Ready VM from - Database-Course-Material >>> Ready_VMs_Standalone
	- oraclelab2.rar

2. Instalaltion of Grid Software / ASM Software / ASM Home / Clusterware Home / Clusterware Software
	a. Download ASM/GRID/Cluster software (19c) - https://edelivery.oracle.com (Oracle Database 19c 19.3.0.0.0)
	b. Install ASM/GRID/Cluster Software/(ASM Home)
		- Copy ASM SW from lapttop/Desktop to VM (oraclelab2)
			- Use winscp 
			- Shared folder

		- Directory creation & SW unzip 
			- mkdir -p /u01/app/19.0.0.0/grid
			- unzip /media/sf_Software/Grid_19c_Software/V982068-01.zip -d /u01/app/19.0.0.0/grid

		- yum install oracle* --skip-broken 
		- yum -y install oracle-database-ee-19c
			https://docs.oracle.com/en/database/oracle/oracle-database/19

		-Optional (if used above rpm installation) User & group create 
			# groupadd dba
			# groupadd oinstall 
			# useradd -g oinstall -G oinstall,dba oracle 
		
		- Change premission
			#chown -R oracle:oinstall /u01

		- passwd oracle

		- share disk creation 
			- /dev/sdb - 3G
			- /dev/sdc - 20G 
			- /dev/sdd - 10G

		- fdisk /dev/sdb - n & w
		- fdisk /dev/sdc - n & w
		- fdisk /dev/sdd - n & w

		- ASMLIB installtion & ASM disk creation 
			- oracleasm init
			- oracleasm configure -i
	
			- oracleasm createdisk ASMDISK1 /dev/sdb1
			- oracleasm createdisk ASMDISK2 /dev/sdc1
			- oracleasm createdisk ASMDISK3 /dev/sdd1

		- ASM SW Installation / GRID SW Installation / ASM Home Installation / Cluster Installation (from GUI screen)
			$ cd /u01/app/19.0.0.0/grid
			$ ./gridSetup.sh 

3. Instalaltion of Database Software / Oracle Software / Oracle Home
	a. Download DB software (19c) - https://edelivery.oracle.com (Oracle Database 19c 19.3.0.0.0)	
		- Oracle Database 19c 19.3.0.0.0 ( Oracle Database In-Memory, Oracle Database Vault ) 	
		- DB - V982063-01.zip	
		- GI - V982068-01.zip	
	
	b. Install Oracle Software (Oracle Home)
		- Copy DB SW from lapttop/Desktop to VM (oraclelab1)
			- Use winscp 
			- Shared folder

		- Directory creation & SW unzip 
			- mkdir -p /u01/app/oracle/product/19.0.0.0/dbhome_1
			- unzip /media/sf_Software/DB_19c_Software/V982063-01.zip -d /u01/app/oracle/product/19.0.0.0/dbhome_1

	Skip these steps 
		- yum install oracle* --skip-broken 
		- yum -y install oracle-database-ee-19c
		- yum -y install oracle-database-ee-21c
			https://docs.oracle.com/en/database/oracle/oracle-database/19

	Skip these steps 
		- Optinal (In case if you installed above RPM)
		- User & group create 
			# groupadd dba
			# groupadd oinstall 
			# useradd -g oinstall -G oinstall,dba oracle 
	
		- Change premission
			# cd /u01/app/oracle/	
			#chown -R oracle:oinstall product

	Skip these steps 
		- passwd oracle
		
		- Database SW Installation / Oracle SW Installation / Oracle Home Installation (from GUI screen as oracle user)
			$ cd /u01/app/oracle/product/19.0.0.0/dbhome_1
			$ ./runInstaller 

4. Creation of Database (DEVDB)
		- Create DATA and RECO diskgroup 
		$ cd /u01/app/19.0.0.0/grid/bin
		$ ./asmca
		
		- Create Database 
		- $ cd /u01/app/oracle/product/19.0.0.0/dbhome_1/bin
		- $ ./dbca

# a database or ASM Configuration Assistant while creating ASM instance.

# A colon, ':', is used as the field terminator.  A new line terminates
